_note: i18n-verifier's checked-in routing corpus — the test of record. POSITIVES cover the verify/check/audit-my-UI-for-internationalization families across phrasing (RTL / bidi, logical vs physical CSS axes, locale-sensitive Intl formatting of numbers/dates/currencies, pluralization, text-expansion budgets, script metrics, encoding, icon mirroring). NEGATIVES are ADVERSARIAL: the OTHER FOUR sibling verifiers' concerns (each a NEGATIVE here, labelled with its owning sibling), plus color-science (color theory/math) and component-decomposer (BUILDING a control, not verifying its locale behaviour). routing-eval measures lexical overlap only; a paraphrase positive may score recall 0 (proxy limit, not a defect).
positives: verify my UI supports RTL for Arabic and Hebrew
check that my CSS uses logical properties instead of left and right
audit my UI for internationalization across scripts and locales
do my numbers, dates, and currencies flow through Intl formatting per locale
verify my buttons have enough text-expansion headroom for German and Russian
check pluralization uses ICU MessageFormat and never string concatenation
is the line-height correct for CJK and Devanagari scripts
verify user-generated strings are bidi-isolated when interpolated into chrome
audit my icons for a correct mirroring policy in RTL
check that every text-bearing surface declares dir and lang
verify this layout flips cleanly from LTR to RTL without re-authoring
does my copy overflow or silently truncate when translated
check encoding and locale-sensitive collation order for sorted lists
audit text-expansion budgets and per-script min body size
negatives: verify my palette clears WCAG AA contrast on every text pair (color-verifier)
check the contrast ratio of my button text against its background (color-verifier)
audit my color scheme for color-blind safety (color-verifier)
verify the focus order and keyboard tab sequence through this form (focus-verifier)
check that interactive targets meet the 24x24 hit-target minimum (focus-verifier)
audit the focus-ring appearance and keyboard operability (focus-verifier)
verify the loading skeleton vs spinner decision and the CLS budget (perf-verifier)
audit perceived latency and the feedback recipe for this async surface (perf-verifier)
check that destructive deletes use undo or type-to-confirm (safety-verifier)
verify the blast radius and audit-trail UX for bulk actions (safety-verifier)
explain the OKLCH color space math and how chroma maps to hue (color-science)
build a zero-dependency locale-aware date-picker web component (component-decomposer)
design the API and parts of a language-switcher component (component-decomposer)
